verdict.rationale: Medusa is headless, so storefront customization means editing your own code. Evidence shows Storefront Development Guides, community-noted Gatsby/Next.js starter kits, and Medusa Cloud storefront hosting with GitHub-based deploys and PR previews. That covers version-controlled deploys and a hosted preview, but nothing documents a templating or theme layer or a local preview workflow. Missing for 10: documented templating/theme layer, local preview/dev-server evidence, in-depth storefront customization docs beyond a page title, independent hands-on corroboration of the deploy flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can customize storefront code with a documented templating layer, local preview, and version-controlled theme deploys

citations.quote: Really love that you have starter kits for both Gatsby and Nextjs
Push from GitHub to the fastest infrastructure.
